solutions.title: Linear scan
solutions.strategy: Check each position until the target is found.

timeComplexity.explanation: The scan may inspect all n values when the target is absent or near the end.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only a loop index is stored.

solutions.title: Rotated binary search
solutions.strategy: Use the sorted half around the midpoint to decide which side can still contain the target.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each comparison removes about half of the remaining search range.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The search uses only two boundaries and a midpoint.
